long_biography.plain_text:
Bosman-Klaassen's public business identity is rooted in the logistics company created by her husband, Wim Bosman. He founded the group with one truck and developed it into a large European transport and warehousing operator. Mainfreight acquired the company in 2011, while certain properties remained under the management of Mr and Mrs Bosman.

After the sale, the family placed its capital in Bonita Groep, a family office built around listed investments, real estate and direct company stakes. Following Wim Bosman's death in 2017, Ans remained closely engaged and the group says she participates in all important decisions. Her daughter Deborah represents the next generation, while professional managers oversee daily operations and investment execution.
